sinopsis.es: No dia em que completa 35 anos, Marcus e sua mãe procuram um lugar no litoral para espalhar as cinzas do pai. Quando sua mãe adoece, ele passa a sentir que o sal do mar onde o pai descansa corrói lentamente a sua vida.
sinopsis.en: On his 35th birthday, Marcus and his mother search for a place on the coast to scatter his father’s ashes. When his mother falls ill, he begins to feel that the salt of the sea where his father rests slowly corrodes his life.
